Hi Samira / procurement team —

Thanks again for the productive discussion today. Quick written recap so we’re all aligned and have a clear set of next actions. I’ve attached a short playbook and the SLA draft for reference (see attachments).

Call highlights / customer pain we heard:
- Latency spikes during peak clinical ingestion windows (evening ET) causing dropped inference requests and downstream retries.
- Strict PHI handling needs: tenant isolation, VPC-only egress, and customer-managed KMS.
- Predictable throughput for triage and embeddings workloads (bursty bursts around batch jobs).

Goals we agreed on:
- Dedicated reserved pool with single-tenant isolation for PHI workloads.
- Baseline throughput to cover steady-state inference for ~2k concurrent sessions and burst to ~5k concurrent requests when batch jobs kick off.
- SLA target: 99.95% uptime for the reserved pool; P99 latency goal <150ms for interactive calls (to be validated in canary).

Preliminary technical recommendation (what we proposed):
- Reserve 8x A100-equivalent GPUs as the initial committed pool (base).
- Autoscale/burst policy up to 20 GPUs for scheduled batch windows (burst capacity will be pre-warmed by a scheduled job).
- Tenant isolation: VPC + dedicated subnet + per-customer KMS integration (we’ll share config checklist).
- Runtime optimizations: quantization profile for embeddings, prefix/KV caching for chat workloads, and continuous batching for high-throughput endpoints.

Commercial & timing notes:
- We suggested a 12-month committed plan with a 30-day canary once capacity is provisioned.
- Next commercial documents we’ll send: SLA draft (attached), a short MOP for onboarding, and a one-page estimate.

Action items (owner / target):
1) Redwood to send: playbook, SLA draft, one-page commercial estimate — Evelyn (EOD Mon 8/17) — attachments included.
2) Customer to confirm target procurement timeline and any specific vendor paperwork — Samira / Procurement (please reply with dates).
3) Schedule technical kickoff (onboarding engineer + infra owners) — Ben to propose 1-hour slots next week.

Attachments: integrahealth-playbook.pdf, sla-draft-v2.docx, MOP-draft.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the one-pager and link to the DocuSign MSA shortly.

Evelyn Hart
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
